parts.name: band-cuff
parts.role: Wrist chassis. Springs over the wrist; the strap takes up the rest of the range.

parts.name: band-cap
parts.role: Removable bay lid. Lip drops into the mouth, thumb notch levers it off with a glove on.

parts.name: band-cam
parts.role: Detachable camera. Three lugs, drop in and twist 25 degrees to a hard stop.

parts.name: band-pad
parts.role: Thenar pressure pad on a compliant arm, so it stays loaded as the thumb opposes.
